After three: Sixers 99, Bulls 93.

Given their significant rebounding advantage so far today, the Sixers could have a larger lead. They just have not defended well enough outside of the second quarter.

items.title: Kon Knueppel has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in four weeks, #Hornets say. Big blow.
items.author: Rod Boone
items.body_excerpt:
Kon Knueppel has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in four weeks, #Hornets say. Big blow.

Brandon Miller has a right hip strain and is out for tomorrow's game against Cleveland.

Dennis Schroder has a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks.
